label: Th(W_N) is complete and decidable: every sentence of the sample is decided by evaluation on N = 2..8; sigma_N is categorical — its models on a domain of size N are the N! copies of W_N (N <= 5)
detail: 10 sentences x 7 frames; N=2: 2 models of sigma_N on [0,N), all copies of W_N; N=3: 6 models of sigma_N on [0,N), all copies of W_N; N=4: 24 models of sigma_N on [0,N), all copies of W_N

label: no finite model of Q: on N elements no successor map is injective and misses 0 (all N^N maps, N <= 7), so Th(W_N) does not interpret Q
detail: N=1: 1 maps, 0 injective-avoiding-0; N=2: 4 maps, 0 injective-avoiding-0; N=3: 27 maps, 0 injective-avoiding-0; N=4: 256 maps, 0 injective-avoiding-0

label: bounded stability: every Delta_0 sentence takes its standard value in every frame above t(phi) — the worked instance (Goldbach below 20, t = 400) in 40 frames above the bound, and a random sample; below the bound frames can disagree
detail: Goldbach<=20: true, t(phi) = 400 (proved bound), empirical threshold N >= 21; 300 random sentences, 82 disagree below their bound

label: records: sum_{i<=K} s^i < s^(K+1) (s = 2, 3, 10; K <= 20); no injection of N elements into R < N records (exhaustive); the certified fraction s^(K+1)/floor(c^L/2) falls to 0
horizon separation: a deterministic run on C configurations halts within C steps or revisits a configuration and never halts — decidable from above by C steps
detail: C <= 5 exhaustive (all maps with a fixed halting state); C = 1000, 200 random systems: decided within C steps

label: on V_4 (65536 sets, Ackermann codes) the Russell class of every u is a set not in u; no set of V_4 contains every set of V_4; x notin x throughout — bounded comprehension has no antinomy
detail: V_4 exhaustive; the only set containing all of V_3 is V_3 itself, a member of V_4 but not of itself

label: the external diagonal: for every listing of n strings the diagonal is missing (n <= 3 exhaustive, n = 60 random); no map [n] -> P([n]) is onto (n <= 3); 2^n > n; the diagonal of a complete finite registry is one of its entries
detail: no outside-the-list element exists when the registry is complete and finite

label: on a finite set counting measure is complete and invariant under every bijection (|X| = 6, all 720 permutations x 64 subsets); no injection X + X -> X (|X| <= 4); every ultrafilter on a 3-set is principal (all 3, of the filters enumerated)
detail: 7 filters on the 3-set, 3 ultrafilters, all principal

label: the iterated singletons emptyset, {emptyset}, {{emptyset}}, ... (7 of them, the last of 65 537 bits) are pairwise distinct with ranks 0, 1, 2, ...: a universal set would be infinite
ch(A) = min A is a member and the least element of every nonempty subset of F_13 (8191 subsets); finite products of nonempty sets are nonempty
an equality-periodic family A_{i+N} = A_i on F_13 has the choice f(i) = min A_i of the same period (50 random families, periods 1..7)
a G-equivariant section exists iff every stabiliser action on its fibre has a fixed point: exhaustive on both sides for random G-families, G = Z/2, Z/3, S_3, fibres of size 1..3
detail: 139 families, 136 with a section; the criterion agrees in every case

label: every subspace of F_5^3 (64 of them) has the greedy minimal basis, independent and spanning; the involution v -> -v on the line fixes no basis over F_p for odd p <= 13 and fixes 1 over F_2
detail: obstruction over F_3, F_5, F_7, F_11, F_13; none over F_2

label: periodic Koenig: in every finite digraph with out-degree >= 1 the greedy walk repeats within |D|+1 steps and is eventually periodic with period <= |D| (exhaustive |D| <= 3, random |D| = 10, 20, 30)

periodic de Bruijn-Erdos (dimension one): the transfer digraph decides c-colorability of all finite subgraphs of a random periodic graph; when they are colorable, a definable sigma^m-periodic coloring with m <= |D'_c| is produced and verified
detail: 40 random periodic graphs (block <= 3, range 1, c = 2, 3): 32 colorable with a periodic coloring found, 8 with a finite obstruction

label: the full second-order theory of W_3 is decided by exhaustive evaluation: 8 subsets, 512 relations, 27 functions; the well-ordering sentence and Dedekind-finiteness are true, the existence of a linear order true, a false sentence false

the Pi_1 sentence 'every even number is a sum of two primes' receives a verdict from each frame about its own domain: true in W_N for every 4 <= N <= 400; the closure over all frames is not a sentence of any frame
detail: 397 frames, all true; no frame decides the unbounded quantifier
